senses.gloss: f.(b. h. טֻמְאָה; טָמֵא)uncleanness, esp. levitical uncleanness, v. טַהֲרָה.
units: <cite ref="Pesachim 19a:9">Pes. 19ᵃ</cite> <he>טוּמְאַת ידים</he> uncleanness of hands by touch.

<cite ref="Moed Katan 5a:16">M. Kat. 5ᵃ</cite> <he>ט׳ קוראה וכ׳</he> the uncleanness (the unclean spot being marked) calls unto him warning &c.; a. v. fr.—Pl. <he>טוּמְאוֹת</he> <cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 1:1">Kel. I, 1</cite>; a. v. fr.
